data.comment:
# Comfy Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash- Image to Video

Generate videos from text prompts or reference images using Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash, a multimodal model that handles text-to-video, image-to-video, keyframe interpolation, and iterative video editing with natural language. Outputs a single MP4 video with optional audio, supporting aspect ratios, resolutions up to 4K, and scene extension. Ideal for cinematic storytelling, product visualization, and rapid video prototyping. Runs on Comfy Cloud and needs Comfy Cloud partner credits.

**How it works:** The Comfy nodes form the complete template graph. Run submits the graph to Comfy Cloud and saves its outputs.

**Try this:** Change the prompt or the Load node inputs and run again to compare results.

Source: https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/blob/1ae390968e323dba24a6991d1860ded051f5a79b/templates/api_google_gemini_omni_flash_1_1_i2v.json (MIT). Model licenses apply separately.

data.model.prompt: Use @Image1 as the first frame, keep the car and the blue studio set exactly unchanged in the opening shot. SHOT ONE (0-1.8s), macro close-up on the side mirror: the blue bodywork and mirror glass reflecting the sweeping floor beam, a thin wisp of haze drifting past. HARD CUT. SHOT TWO (1.8-3.4s), side tracking shot gliding along the car's flank: reflections flowing across the doors, the beam light strobing over the door handles. HARD CUT. SHOT THREE (3.4-5s), wide from behind the car pulling back: the full car centered in the blue studio void, the man leaning on the hood, the floor beam completing one final sweep and settling. Photorealistic fashion car commercial, deep blue palette consistent across all three shots. Audio: a crystalline tick on each cut, a smooth electronic groove building, a final soft bass note as the beam settles. No text overlays, no black frames, no camera shake.
